notes: Read the full 424-line numbered source before editing. Covered the eslint-disable/@ts-nocheck legacy header (L1-2), all imports (L3-16), the exported InsightData interface (L20-27), Severity/Trend unions and the Insight interface (L29-40), the SEVERITY_BORDER hex map (L44-49) and TREND_ICON map (L51-55), and every analyzer: analyzeChargingCost (L59-101), analyzeEfficiencyTrend (L103-135), analyzeBatteryHealth (L137-170), analyzeOptimalCharging (L172-202), analyzeVampireDrain (L204-235), analyzeDrivingPatterns (L237-270), analyzeCostSavings (L272-291), analyzeRangeOptimization (L293-318), plus the InsightsEngine component, its useFormatting()/formatCurrency wiring, the eight-branch useMemo accumulation (L322-361), the empty-list null return (L363), and the full FadeIn/header/grid/GlassPanel render tree with severity border, tinted icon box, title row, trend icon, and description (L365-422). Arithmetic, ordering, thresholds (<2/<4/<3, >10/<5, >8, >50, >20, 80, >=90/>=80/>=85), constants (8.5 L/100km, $1.50/L, 150 Wh/km, 500 km, *1000, *24, *12, /86_400_000), and every English string are reproduced byte-for-byte including the CO2 subscript and the 20-80% en dashes.

DOM/web-only modules were replaced with React Native primitives: the framer-motion FadeIn became a local Animated FadeIn (opacity 0->1, translateY 12->0, 400ms, Easing.out(Easing.quad), delay 150ms for the source delay={0.15}) honouring AccessibilityInfo reduced-motion; GlassPanel maps to the native ui/GlassPanel; the outer div/h3/div grid/span/p map to View/AppText with StyleSheet; lucide-react icons (DollarSign/Zap/Battery/BatteryCharging/Shield/Car/Leaf/Clock header Lightbulb and TrendingUp/TrendingDown/ArrowRight) map to short AppText glyphs ($, ZP, BT, BC, SH, EV, LF, CK, LB, UP, DN, >) drawn from the existing SemanticIcon glyph vocabulary, with the per-insight icon and tinted box still coloured by the dynamic severity hex via the `${borderColor}15` 8-digit-hex alpha that RN supports natively. No browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported.

fmtNumber and safeNumber are inlined verbatim from @/lib/numberFormat (same safeNumber guard, same toLocaleString with min/max fraction digits, same en-US locale fallback, same default precision 2) because no native parity module exists; every source fmtNumber call already passes an explicit precision so output matches. trendColor is inlined verbatim from @/lib/colors (up->#ef4444, down->#10b981, else #6b7280). The web useFormatting().formatCurrency is rebuilt locally from the native useSettings web-parity hook applying the identical rules: currency_symbol (trimmed, else '$') + fmtNumber(amount, decimals ?? floor(decimal_precision>=0 else 2)); useMemo keeps the [data, formatCurrency] dependency parity. The neutral trend's CSS var('--text-secondary') maps to tokens colors.textSecondary.

The source is @ts-nocheck because two @/api/client shapes still read legacy pre-SI field names. ChargingSession (charge_energy_added, fast_charger_type, end_battery_level) and EnergyStats (total_energy_used_kwh, total_distance_km, avg_efficiency_wh_km) are reproduced as local legacy interfaces so the port is fully typed without @ts-nocheck while preserving the exact unit handling (kWh/km, percent, count); Drive, BatteryReport, VampireDrainStats, and MileageStats already use matching field names and are imported from the canonical native ../../api/types. The web file has no i18n (hardcoded English), so strings are kept literal rather than wrapped in t(); state/prop names (data, InsightData, Insight, severity, trend, trendGood, id) and the responsive grid intent (grid-cols-1 / md:grid-cols-2 reproduced as a flexWrap row of flexBasis:260/flexGrow:1 cards) are preserved.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet, and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
